scope: Standard runtime scheduling and local image replacement; private operational evidence. Source hashes identify the uncommitted working-tree artifact.

policy.selection: Least recently selected eligible account across models; synchronous forwarding reservation; checkpointed engine last use seeds ordering.
policy.concurrency: One Standard account slot from admission start through completion/settlement attempt; engine concurrency one; acknowledgement alone never releases running work.
policy.quota: Immediate provider-feedback exclusion and checkpoint; reported reset respected, otherwise existing exponential 60s to 30min cooldown; one real recovery request. Explicit central denials have process-local 60s to 30min backoff.
policy.authority: Existing central account assignment/lease/budget ledger unchanged. Execution DB remains identity/outcomes only. No new migration.
policy.identity: Lookup precedes selection; no retry/failover after uncertainty. Duplicate cannot clear original pending lock.
policy.public: New pre-dispatch 503 service_busy uses an allowlisted fixed body and Retry-After 5. No account diagnostics returned.

verification.scope: Real local HTTP/WebSocket engines, synthetic central and execution stores; includes ten Standard policy tests.

verification.command: npm run docs:check:build and focused scheduler-marker scan
verification.result: No compiled private markers or private runtime trace paths; initial command also reported expected stale documentation fingerprints pending explicit review.

localAcceptance.scope: local VM separation on one trusted Mac; no provider generation or cloud deployment

installation.workflow: Built under new tag, inspected and loaded only into Standard VM; reinstalled reviewed overlay; confirmed empty/closed Standard via viewer status; stopped Standard runtime; normal up waited for previous owner heartbeat; verified both pools.

limits: No real provider sign-in, quota spend, generation, throughput measurement or public application deployment.
Checkpoint saves are best effort; local central-denial backoff and forwarding order are process-local. Central authority still governs after restart.
Request fairness is not token fairness; busy accounts are skipped and a sole eligible account can serve successive completed requests.
Monitor health remains central metadata, not a live feed of local scheduler capacity.
Initial unprivileged fixture run hit local-listener EPERM and a Node assertion; rerun with local networking passed.
No PostgreSQL schemas, policies or grants changed; retained database acceptance is baseline evidence.
